about: The host's chain words, ids and explorers, copied on 2026-11-28 from HivemindOS's shared core at 60d773099a: core/chain-marks.ts CHAIN_MARKS (slug, caip2, explorer) and core/agent-figure.ts AGENT_MODEL_CHAINS (slug and chainId, with Ethereum). tests/test_chains.py holds scripts/chains.py to these, so a chain word here cannot drift from the host's without a failing test.
